slides.title: COALESCE = [[pehla non-NULL]]
points: **COALESCE(a, b, c)** left se check karta
slides.note: Jaise plan A, plan B, plan C: jo pehle chale wahi 😌

slides.title: Default [[value]] do
slides.note: Type same chahiye, isliye **CAST**. MySQL: CHAR, PG/SQL Server: VARCHAR(10)

slides.title: Divide by zero [[bachao]]
slides.code:
SELECT name,
  sales / NULLIF(visits, 0)
    AS conversion
FROM stores;
slides.note: visits = 0 → NULLIF ne NULL kiya → **error nahi**, result NULL 🙌

slides.why: DB badla to query tooti. **COALESCE** standard hai, sab jagah same chalega

caption:
NULL ka ilaaj: COALESCE ki goli 💊

NULL ke do doctor: COALESCE aur NULLIF!
Is post mein:
✅ COALESCE se default value
✅ Phone → email → N/A fallback
✅ NULLIF se divide-by-zero se bachao
✅ COALESCE vs ISNULL / IFNULL
